title: ixora boerlagei
intro: Ixora boerlagei, commonly known as the Red Ixora or Jungle Flame, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is known for its vibrant red, pink, or white flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been used to treat fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, and its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Ixora boerlagei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
